reviews.text: I wanted to thank you for all the interest and compassion you showed in helping my cat. It was the very first time I felt complete trust, so even though it was quite far from home, I still chose to continue having him examined and treated by them. He was in a very bad state due to an abscess from a scratch, resulting in an open wound. After a few sessions and antibiotics, he made a complete recovery. I highly recommend them; they are truly excellent.

Every time my family and I have visited Dr. Vescio, we've been satisfied. Last summer, my 20-year-old dog was incredibly ill; we thought there was nothing we could do, but thanks to the doctor's care, she recovered almost immediately.
Besides being a professional, he's very humane and loves animals (something that, after several negative experiences, is not at all a given). He clearly loves his job.
I recommend everyone to go to him.
The only shame was not having met him sooner!
